RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  April 27, 2010/V aisakha 7, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Civil Aviation; Finance; Health and Family Welfare; Heavy
Industries and Public Enterprises; Panchayati Raj; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Rural Development; Shipping)
Total number of questions — 20
Check on illegal medical practice in
the country
*441. SHRI NAND KUMAR SAI: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the issue of illegal medical
practice by fake  doctors/quacks in the
country has been discussed by the National
Human Rights Commission in the recent
past;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the names of various organisations
which participated in the discussion;
(d) the details of measures suggested
by various organisations to check the illegal
medical practice in the country; and
(e) the details of steps taken by
Government, so far, in this regard?
Legislation to end discrimination
against HIV/AIDS citizens
*442. DR. E.M. SUDARSANA
NATCHIAPPAN: Wi ll the Minister of
HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
bring a legislation to save the HIV/AIDS
affected citizens from discrimination; and
(b) if so, by when will this legislation
be brought?
Review of NRHM
†*443. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the review of
National Rural Health Mission (NRHM)
is carried out every year by a Common
Review Mission;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it has been mentioned in
the report of the Common Review Mission
that the use of costly branded medicines,
in place of cheap generic medicines, is being
imposed in rural areas; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
reaction of Government thereto?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
135

136
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Legislation to check siphoning off of
black money
*444. PROF. P . J. KURIEN: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of efforts being made by
Government to bring back the vast sums of
black money siphoned off from the country
and deposited in the banks in tax havens
abroad;
(b) whether Government is
contemplating to modify and strengthen
the existing laws, or to bring any new
comprehensive legislation to check  such
siphoning off of black money from the
country; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Commission to doctors on prescribing
medicines
†*445. SHRI BHAGWATI SINGH:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that doctors get
upto fifty per cent flat commission on
prescribing several medicines;
(b) if so, whether Government is taking
any measure to control this practice of
payment of commission to doctors in the
health sector; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Incidence  of  anaemia  and
malnourishment among
young mothers
*446. SHRI MOHD. ALI KHAN: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is a high incidence of
anaemia and malnourishment among young
mothers with little or no access to child
planning, especially in the rural areas of
our country as compared to urban areas;
(b) if so, the comparative details thereof
in each State in the Eleventh Five Year Plan;
and
(c) the funds allocated and spent in this
regard in Andhra Pradesh, compared to
other States for the period, urban and rural
area-wise?
Free healthcare for senior citizens
*447. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has any plan
to formulate a healthcare policy providing
free healthcare to senior citizens in hospitals
in view of the fact that they face great
hardships in getting treatment;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Revision of price of natural gas
*448. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
hike the natural gas prices produced by
State-run Oil and Natural Gas Corporation
(ONGC) and Oil India Ltd. (OIL) by as
much as 30 per cent;
(b) if so, whether his Ministry has
circulated a Cabinet Note for the move
under the Administered Price Mechanism
(APM); and
(c) if so, by what time a final decision in
this regard is likely to be taken?

137
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Special tax on indigenously produced
oil and gas
*449. SHRI P. RAJEEVE: W ill the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether any special tax is imposed
on crude oil explored and produced in the
country which is same as the customs duty
on imported crude oil;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) how the introduction of 5 per cent
customs duty has been reflected in the price
of petrol and diesel in the retail outlets?
Allocation of gas at APM rates
*450. SHRI KANJIBHAI PA TEL
